answer: In a decentralized AI network, a Sybil resistance mechanism like the "plume" voting scheme can mitigate fake-identity attacks. By having agents cast votes on a per-transaction basis, an attacker attempting to create multiple identities must expend resources to generate a large number of votes, creating a significant "plume" of wasted effort. This approach is particularly effective in resource-constrained environments, as it would be akin to trying to navigate a narrow "canyon" with an endless supply of lotus flowers - impractical and unsustainable.
